30 years in the business is just the beginning

We got our start in 1995 by specializing in website development at a time when the internet looked… a little different.

 

We’re not into trends, but we’ve always been quick to pick up on new technologies that affect the way people communicate; we were one of the first agencies to leverage variable data publishing and were early adopters of using social media, augmented reality, and marketing automation to help our clients connect with their audiences. 

 

Oh, and we still make great websites, too.

Excellent team & great support

We've been working with Trekk for a little over a year. Laura and the team helped us to develop a new brand, a new website and migrate to a new CRM. I'm sure we weren't the easiest to work with because it took time for us to fully embrace the new brand, but the Trekk team was patient and worked with our management team to fine tune the new brand. From day one, the communication has been wonderful; responsive and knowledgeable. It is wonderful to work with a team that is so responsive, from the top down. Our CRM migration hasn't been easy, since we've had some push back from some of our team members, but the Trekk team has been so helpful in identifying solutions to the issues we've encountered and has made the experience easier, and almost enjoyable! If you're in the market for a new marketing team, Trekk is the team you're looking for!

 

Juely Bartholomew
Renaissance Historic Exteriors

Obsessed with Trekk

My experience with Trekk is nothing short of fantastic each and every day I interact with them. I approached Trekk with a long wish list including a complete rebranding of my company, a new website, and implementation of inbound sales. And all to be completed within 2 months. I quickly realized that Trekk lives and breathes their company motto every day — a tech driven creative services company obsessed with exploration. This obsession and their hugely talented staff quickly explored and learned my world of industrial equipment and presented us to the world with a fresh and trendy new image. In addition their knowledge and experience with HubSpot CRM has streamlined our sales efforts and keeps my sales team focused on our goals.
